findings.next_action: Obtain version-matched authoritative license/notice evidence and assess native coverage; no package-name inference. No additional source download was performed.
findings.observation: No LICENSE/NOTICE candidate exists in these three wheels. Their root METADATA respectively declares SPDX MIT, legacy MIT, and an Apache Software License classifier only; no License-File header is present. Tokenizers native/transitive notice completeness cannot be established from its classifier.

LICENSE_GEOS identifies GEOS shared libraries and LGPLv2.1. This is an actual bundled component notice; applicability/redistribution requirements must be respected. It is not evidence that private CPU execution is prohibited.

Vendored autocommand 2.2.2 contains LGPLv3 text; generated validation-code NOTICE includes MPL terms. This is not an all-MIT dependency closure. Future redistribution/native applicability has not been fully mapped.

Third-party text includes LGPLv2.1 for bundled FFmpeg library binaries. The non-commercial keyword occurs in a sentence expressly permitting commercial and non-commercial use (OpenSSL attribution), not a noncommercial-only prohibition. Preserve all component notices; native-library applicability is not exhaustively reviewed.

Bundled libgfortran notices state GPLv3 with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. GPL/AGPL words inside full license text are not proof that the whole wheel or this project is GPL/AGPL. Component conditions need correct attribution.

Pillow contains component dual-license/toolchain discussion; PDFium ICU notices include Autoconf/configuration-script exceptions; PSF historical terms reference GPL. No blanket wheel incompatibility follows from keyword matches. Complete native-component applicability remains unverified.

MODEL_LICENSES.md explicitly identifies the three bundled PaddleOCR-derived ONNX files and Apache-2.0 terms, distinguishes upstream ownership/conversion, and states that permissions are not limited to non-commercial use. Upstream independent provenance and per-model hashes were not separately revalidated; the acquired wheel hash covers the packaged bytes. No OCR or separate model request occurred.
Actual LICENSE grants use/copy/modify/distribution with notice retention. The automated signature missed the wording variant; no missing-license claim is made.

scope: Bounded text inspection of all discovered notices plus targeted context review. License expressions and filename matching do not establish completeness for every bundled native/Rust dependency or give legal approval.
